generate_rpn_on_dataset: run RPN inference on a dataset using a single or multi GPU to generate region proposals
multi_gpu_generate_rpn_on_dataset: run parallel multi-GPU RPN inference on a dataset by spawning subprocesses and collating results
generate_rpn_on_range: run RPN inference on a range of images in a dataset using a single GPU
im_proposals: generate RPN region proposals and scores on a single image using a loaded model
evaluate_proposal_file: evaluate box proposal average recall from a saved RPN proposal file and log results
